title: feat(auto-hide): configurable tiers, settings UI, media proxy fixes
body:
## Summary

- **Auto-hide settings UI** — new `AutoHideSettings` component in the Settings tab for configuring auto-hide tiers (Immediate + Threshold), trusted clients, categories, and thresholds. Uses `getApiHeaders()` for CF Access auth.
- **ReportWatcher tier-aware auto-hide** — `processAutoHide` now reads tier config from DO storage, routes reports to immediate (single trusted-client report) or threshold (N unique reporters per category) processing paths. Threshold counting is category-scoped via exact `reason` match in D1.
- **Media proxy hardening** — fixes a dead-end state where proxy-fetched content that isn't renderable (e.g. non-video blob) caused a permanent black frame instead of falling back to the broken-media icon. Adds `key={displayUrl}` to force remount when proxy URL arrives.
- **QUARANTINE recognized as blocked** — `useMediaStatus` now treats `QUARANTINE` (moderation-service D1 action) as a blocked state, so the action bar correctly shows "Unblock Media" instead of "Block Media & Ban Event" for quarantined items.
- **Pending review filters** — auto-hide actions excluded from resolved targets so auto-hidden items appear in the pending review queue. Category filter cleared when toggling pending review on.
- **BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET** binding added to prod and staging wrangler configs (Secrets Store).
- **Blob URL cleanup** on unmount for `InlineMediaPreview` (memory leak fix).

## What changed (by area)

### Worker (Durable Object)
- `ReportWatcher.ts`: tier-aware `processAutoHide`, category-scoped `countUniqueReporters`, config GET/PUT endpoints, `isAlreadyAutoHidden` deduplication
- `ReportWatcher.test.ts`: 163 tests covering immediate/threshold tiers, trusted client gating, config validation, deduplication
- `index.ts`: forward request body to DO for PUT /config

### Frontend
- `AutoHideSettings.tsx`: new settings UI with chip lists for categories/clients, tier config, client-side validation
- `MediaPreview.tsx`: proxy blob recovery, blob URL cleanup, `key={displayUrl}` remount
- `useMediaStatus.ts`: QUARANTINE recognized as blocked
- `Reports.tsx`: auto-hide actions excluded from resolved, category filter cleared on pending review toggle
- `SettingsDashboard.tsx`: mounts `AutoHideSettings`

### Config
- `wrangler.prod.toml`, `wrangler.staging.toml`: BLOSSOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET secrets store binding

## Test plan

- [x] Deploy to staging (test instance), verify auto-hide settings load and save
- [x] Trigger threshold-tier auto-hide with 2 reports from different pubkeys, same category — confirm event is hidden
- [x] Verify single cross-category report does NOT trigger threshold (category scoping)
- [x] Confirm CSAM/immediate tier fires on single trusted-client report
- [ ] Open a report with quarantined media — verify "Unblock Media" button appears (not "Block Media & Ban Event")
- [ ] Verify media proxy shows broken icon (not black frame) when proxy content is unrenderable
- [ ] Verify pending review toggle shows auto-hidden items, not resolved items
